documents.title: Madison County 2026 budget, as filed with the state
documents.note: Posted on the Arkansas Transparency portal (artransparency.gov) in May 2026. 141 pages. Amounts are the Budget Detail Report 'Original Budget' column (report run 12/13/2025 for January 2026; no expenditures posted), Group/Department/Fund Totals rows column.
